Brian Gephart to chief financial officer, effective October 1, 2026.
Gephart will succeed David Day, who is retiring after a decade overseeing Magnite’s financial operations.
Gephart has served as Magnite’s chief accounting officer since June 2021 and brings more than 20 years of finance and capital-markets experience.
Before Magnite, Gephart was CFO and principal financial officer at Leaf Group.

title: Magnite announces CFO transition
